fact: On 23 November 2025 the Ministry of Education's Information and Documentation Centre issued the annual statistical guide for the 2023-2024 school year, with statistics on educational institutions, pupils and staff by region (news item; it does not say the figures come from school returns).
title: مركز المعلومات والتوثيق يصدر الدليل الإحصائي السنوي للعام الدراسي 2023–2024م
publisher: Ministry of Education, Information and Documentation Centre
